summary: Both backend and frontend scope tested against public preview URL. Core feed behaviors pass: admin login opens feed, /api/feed excludes non-visible questions, 3 consecutive batches in one session do not repeat IDs, and category=Bilim returns only Bilim. Guest login works on API and UI. Register screen renders and submits, but validation error rendering is poor ([object Object]). Also found a backend regression on legacy POST /api/auth/register (500).

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when payload matches Credentials shape (identifier/password). RCA from backend log: register() uses Credentials model but accesses credentials.email and credentials.name, causing AttributeError.

minor.endpoint: Push integration (/api/v1/push relay used by notifications)
minor.issue: Backend logs repeatedly show push trigger 401 Unauthorized (EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY placeholder). Notification persistence works, push delivery is not working.

ui_bugs.issue: On register submit validation failure (422), UI displays '[object Object]' instead of user-readable message.

react_native_issues.issue: RN Web warnings continue: shadow* deprecated (use boxShadow), pointerEvents prop deprecated (use style.pointerEvents).

action_items: Fix POST /api/auth/register contract mismatch in backend/server.py (request model vs accessed fields).
Improve frontend API error parsing for FastAPI validation arrays so auth-error-text shows a proper message instead of [object Object].
Set valid push key or guard push relay warnings if push is intentionally disabled in this environment.
Main agent can run reset_clean_start.py after review to return DB to 1 admin / 0 question clean state (as planned).
critical_code_review_comments: Feed randomization and cycle logic in random_feed_questions() correctly tracks user+category with feed_seen/feed_cycle_state and passed non-repeat 3-batch test in fresh session.
published_question_filter() enforces is_published=true, is_active=true, is_hidden=false, is_deleted=false; API behavior validated against DB-side excluded question IDs.
frontend/src/api.ts still contains legacy register() calling /auth/register, which currently maps to broken backend path and can trigger 500 for legacy clients.
Frontend backend URL is read from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/Constants extra backendUrl; this differs from EXPO_BACKEND_URL wording in platform guidance, but runtime routing works in preview.

success_rate.backend: 86% (6/7 checked behaviors passed; 1 critical legacy endpoint failure)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (core auth/feed/flatlist flows passed; register error rendering bug remains)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed script run. Test created temporary guest sessions only; main agent already plans cleanup with reset_clean_start.py.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_swipedia_v8_feed_batches.py as regression baseline for feed filters + non-repeat batches + Bilim filter. Re-test POST /api/auth/register after backend fix and verify register UI message rendering for 422 details.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/auth/register uses Credentials schema (identifier,password) but implementation expects credentials.email/name/password. When called with identifier/password, server throws AttributeError in register() at backend/server.py:662 and returns 500. Register UI '[object Object]' issue comes from frontend error handling showing non-string FastAPI detail payload without normalization.
